description: This file appears to be a shell script used for configuring and controlling diagnostic LEDs on a device running OpenWrt. It reads configuration files and JSON data to determine the status LED associated with diagnostics and provides functions to set LED states based on system status.

methods.name: preinit_match_diag_led
methods.description: Determines the diagnostic LED configuration from the board JSON or detected board info

methods.name: match_diag_led
methods.description: Checks if a given configuration entry corresponds to the diagnostic LED and sets the status LED path

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Retrieves the current diagnostic status LED based on configuration files

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the provided argument (e.g., preinit, failsafe, done)
